title: IVG Savr 3000 Peach Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Peach Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods bring together mellow, juicy Peach with a bright streak of Menthol to keep things fresh. The result is a fruit-meets-frost blend that’s smooth and satisfying, perfect for everyday use. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, alongside a 4ml refill reservoir that feeds the pod as you vape. The click-fit design makes assembly easy and mess-free, with no need for coil changes or manual refilling. Designed for use with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit only, and powered by mesh coil technology for a smooth MTL vape with consistent flavour throughout. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
